content.title: Everything We Know About Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2

This article contains spoilers for Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3, Episode #12 With the release of episode 12, titled "Sendai Colony," Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 officially came to an end, much to the surprise of fans. While many fans held out hope for two consecutive cours, the anime's official X account announced that episode 59 marked the finale of season 3, which hints at a longer wait for Jujutsu Kaisen's Culling Game Part 2. Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 reached the peak of the Winter 2016 anime season, trending every Thursday with a new episode, each one more impressive than the last. While the fact that Season 3 didn't have two cours implies a longer break, fans can take comfort in the details revealed about when Jujutsu Kaisen's anime might return. Unfortunately for fans eagerly awaiting Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2, neither MAPPA nor the series' production company, Toho Animation, has yet confirmed a release date. Jujutsu Kaisen Episode 59 ended with a message of "to be continued." However, factors such as the difficulty of animating future Jujutsu Kaisen's story arcs and MAPPA's production schedule could lengthen the wait for fans. Cursed Energy Assessment · Grade Evaluation Jujutsu KaisenTrivia Challenge “Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one.” Eight questions spanning the world of Jujutsu Kaisen — from cursed spirits and sorcerers to Domain Expansions and the King of Curses. Every wrong answer is a plausible decoy. Do you have Special Grade knowledge? Cursed Archives Editorial 8 questions · 3 min read 👻CursesKing of Curses ✨SorcerersSpecial Grade 🌈DomainsExpand! ⚡TechniquesInfinity… 📘LoreGolden Age DOMAIN EXPANSION → 01 The series begins when Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed object — the finger of a legendary curse known as the King of Curses, the most powerful cursed spirit in history. Who is this ancient being? AMahito BJogo CRyomen Sukuna DRika Orimoto ✓ Correct! Ryomen Sukuna is the King of Curses — an ancient, immensely powerful sorcerer from over a thousand years ago whose cursed essence was split into twenty indestructible fingers. When Yuji swallows one, Sukuna is reborn inside him, setting the entire story in motion. ✗ Cursed failure! The answer is Ryomen Sukuna. Mahito is a cursed spirit who manipulates souls, Jogo is a volcano-type curse, and Rika is the Queen of Curses from Jujutsu Kaisen 0. Only Sukuna holds the title of King of Curses. NEXT → 02 The strongest jujutsu sorcerer alive is a blindfolded teacher at Tokyo Jujutsu High who possesses the legendary Six Eyes and the Limitless cursed technique. His birth alone shifted the balance of the jujutsu world. Who is he? ASuguru Geto BSatoru Gojo CYuta Okkotsu DKento Nanami ✓ Correct! Satoru Gojo is the strongest sorcerer in the modern era, wielding the Six Eyes and Limitless technique that grants him Infinity — an ability that makes him virtually untouchable. His confident declaration “Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one” became iconic. ✗ Cursed failure! The answer is Satoru Gojo. Suguru Geto is his former best friend turned enemy, Yuta Okkotsu is a Special Grade sorcerer from JJK 0, and Kento Nanami is a Grade 1 sorcerer and former salaryman. Only Gojo holds the title of the strongest. NEXT → 03 The pinnacle of jujutsu sorcery is a technique that creates a separate space with a guaranteed hit against anyone trapped inside. This ultimate ability is declared by name before activation. What is it called? ADomain Expansion BBinding Vow CReverse Cursed Technique DBlack Flash ✓ Correct! Domain Expansion is the supreme technique in jujutsu — a sorcerer manifests their innate domain as a physical space where their attacks cannot miss. Gojo’s Unlimited Void, Sukuna’s Malevolent Shrine, and Mahito’s Self-Embodiment of Perfection are among the most devastating. ✗ Cursed failure! The answer is Domain Expansion. A Binding Vow is a contract that trades conditions for power, Reverse Cursed Technique converts cursed energy into healing, and Black Flash is a critical hit that applies cursed energy within 0.000001 seconds of a physical hit. NEXT → 04 Early in the series, Yuji Itadori develops an unintentional fighting style where his cursed energy arrives a moment after his physical punch, creating a devastating double impact. What is this technique called? ABlack Flash BCursed Strike CSoul Multiplicity DDivergent Fist ✓ Correct! Divergent Fist occurs because Yuji’s cursed energy is delayed behind his physical blow, creating two impacts in quick succession. While initially seen as a unique technique, it’s actually a sign of Yuji’s inexperience with cursed energy flow — he eventually learns to unify them properly. ✗ Cursed failure! The answer is Divergent Fist. Black Flash is a separate technique where cursed energy is applied within a fraction of a second of impact, creating a spatial distortion. Divergent Fist is Yuji’s signature early-series move caused by his lagging cursed energy. NEXT → 05 A second-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High possesses a hereditary cursed speech technique that imbues his words with cursed energy, forcing anyone who hears them to obey. To avoid accidentally cursing people, he only speaks using rice ball ingredients. Who is he? AMaki Zenin BToge Inumaki CPanda DNoritoshi Kamo ✓ Correct! Toge Inumaki is the Inumaki clan descendant who wields Cursed Speech — his words become commands that others are forced to obey. He limits his vocabulary to onigiri ingredients like “salmon,” “tuna mayo,” and “kelp” to prevent accidentally harming people with his power. ✗ Cursed failure! The answer is Toge Inumaki. Maki Zenin has incredible physical prowess but limited cursed energy, Panda is a cursed corpse created by Principal Yaga, and Noritoshi Kamo uses Blood Manipulation. Only Inumaki speaks in rice ball ingredients to control his Cursed Speech. NEXT → 06 Yuji, Megumi, and Nobara are first-year students at a school that trains jujutsu sorcerers to fight cursed spirits. This institution, where Gojo serves as a teacher, is located in Tokyo. What is it called? ACursed Energy Academy BSorcerer Technical College CTokyo Jujutsu High DZenin Clan Dojo ✓ Correct! Tokyo Jujutsu High (Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical College) is where sorcerers train to exorcise cursed spirits. It’s one of two jujutsu schools in Japan — the other being Kyoto Jujutsu High, led by Principal Gakuganji. Their annual Exchange Event is a major arc in the series. ✗ Cursed failure! The answer is Tokyo Jujutsu High. The Zenin clan is one of the three great sorcerer families but not a school. Tokyo Jujutsu High is the institution hidden behind a barrier where Gojo, Nanami, and other sorcerers guide the next generation. NEXT → 07 Sukuna’s Domain Expansion is unique — instead of creating an enclosed barrier, it manifests as an open shrine with a guaranteed hit range of up to 200 meters. This makes it one of the most powerful domains ever seen. What is it called? AMalevolent Shrine BUnlimited Void CChimera Shadow Garden DCoffin of the Iron Mountain ✓ Correct! Malevolent Shrine is Sukuna’s Domain Expansion — a Buddhist shrine adorned with skulls that delivers relentless slashing attacks. Unlike other domains, it has no barrier, which is considered a Binding Vow that massively increases its effective range and power. ✗ Cursed failure! The answer is Malevolent Shrine. Unlimited Void is Gojo’s domain that overwhelms targets with infinite information, Chimera Shadow Garden is Megumi’s domain, and Coffin of the Iron Mountain is Jogo’s volcanic domain. Sukuna’s barrierless Malevolent Shrine is considered the pinnacle. NEXT → 08 Jujutsu Kaisen became one of the best-selling manga series in history and a massive anime hit animated by Studio MAPPA. The manga was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump. Who is the mangaka (creator) behind Jujutsu Kaisen? ATatsuki Fujimoto BKoyoharu Gotouge CYuji Kaku DGege Akutami ✓ Correct! Gege Akutami is the creator of Jujutsu Kaisen, which began serialization in Weekly Shonen Jump in 2018. Akutami’s dark, complex storytelling and intricate power system have made JJK one of the defining manga and anime of its generation. ✗ Cursed failure! The answer is Gege Akutami. Tatsuki Fujimoto created Chainsaw Man, Koyoharu Gotouge created Demon Slayer, and Yuji Kaku created Hell’s Paradise. Only Gege Akutami is the mind behind the world of cursed energy, Sukuna, and Jujutsu Kaisen. REVEAL MY SCORE → Assessment Complete Your Sorcerer Grade / 8 Are you Special Grade — or just a cursed spirit waiting to be exorcised? ↻ EXPAND DOMAIN AGAIN Jujutsu Kaisen is arguably MAPPA's biggest franchise, but that doesn't mean the studio can't take a break from the series to work on other anime projects. While Dorohedoro Season 2 is slated to premiere as part of the spring 2026 lineup, MAPPA has other upcoming projects besides Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4, such as Chainsaw Man—Assassins Arc and Oblivion Battery Season 2. When To Expect News About Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Although there isn't much info about Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4, fans won't have to wait long for news. Jujutsu Kaisen will host a panel at AnimeJapan 2026, which will take place on March 28, 2026. The fact that Jujutsu Kaisen is scheduled for the Red Stage, usually reserved for major announcements, indicates a possible update about the new season. Likewise, even if there isn't a major announcement at AnimeJapan, MAPPA has already set a date for the next Jujutsu Kaisen update. As part of its 15th anniversary celebration, MAPPA launched a new website teasing a lineup announcement event on the studio's official YouTube channel for June 2026, confirming that details about Jujutsu Kaisen and Chainsaw Man will be revealed. Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2 Story Details There are still many mysteries in the series, such as why the Angel helped Megumi, whether they will manage to save Tsumiki Fushiguro and free Satoru Gojo from the prison realm, the events of Maki's colony, and if Choso and Yuki will be able to protect Tengen. So Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 will be more adrenaline-pumping than previous installments. For the time being, although there isn't a release window yet for Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4: The Culling Game Part 2, given that the manga ended with 271 chapters, there's still plenty to adapt in the anime. New developments are on the horizon for the franchise, so fans should patiently wait for more Jujutsu Kaisen updates.
